confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, booking pages or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is less certain because winter (July) rates vary widely by property and season. Puerto Natales is a remote gateway town with higher prices than mainland Chilean cities, so the figures are adjusted upward for that. FX: the RBA value was taken from search-result summaries of RBA pages, not read directly from the RBA table. The 2026-10-16 figure may not be published yet if checked before the 4.00 pm AEST fix.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Punta Arenas and other Chilean Patagonian tourist towns, adjusted upward for the Torres del Paine gateway premium and remote supply costs. July is low season in Patagonia, so accommodation is set below peak-summer levels.
